data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 8.3m (2013: GBP 71.6m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. Of the prior year surplus, US$104.1m and GBP 0.2m related to the release of reserves on Thai Floods.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of reserves related to the Thai Floods contributing to the prior year surplus

named_events.loss_description: release of reserves on Thai Floods noted as contributing to prior year surplus

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 174.135m. During the 2014 calendar year the syndicate recorded a net prior-year surplus of GBP 8.3m (a release), driven by reassessment of claims on prior accident years including a release of reserves related to the Thai Floods. The reported figure is a NET amount (after reinsurance recoveries); no gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the notes, so the net release is used as the quantified prior-year development.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) was provided in the notes. The report explicitly states a NET prior-year surplus of GBP 8.3m; per extraction rules this NET figure is used as a last-resort fallback and flagged accordingly. The claims development table in the report is explicitly presented 'after reinsurance recoveries' (i.e. NET), so it could not be used to calculate a GROSS prior-year movement. Where event-year was not explicitly stated for 'Thai Floods' the commonly known year 2011 is used with moderate confidence.
